final: WITH telescope_counts AS (SELECT observstation, COUNT(*) as telesc_count FROM telescopes GROUP BY observstation), totals AS (SELECT COUNT(*) as total_count FROM telescopes), shares AS (SELECT tc.observstation, tc.telesc_count, tc.telesc_count * 1.0 / t.total_count as share, t.total_count FROM telescope_counts tc CROSS JOIN totals t), avg_share AS (SELECT AVG(share) as avg_s FROM shares) SELECT s.observstation, s.telesc_count, s.share, s.share - a.avg_s as gap FROM shares s CROSS JOIN avg_share a WHERE s.share > a.avg_s ORDER BY gap DESC LIMIT 10
